_doc: City Planner building classes: 0 A.D. template Identity classes (Classes + VisibleClasses, any civ), checked in public/simulation/templates/template_structure_*.xml. A building whose template has one of these classes is placed by the City Planner (Jev); every other building stays with Petra, fixed where she put it (civic centre, storehouse, farmstead, field, market, mess hall, senate ...). 'Defense Tower' = class StoneTower (template_structure_defensive_tower_stone); sentry towers (SentryTower) stay with Petra. 'words' = the noun Jev reads for that class.
